availability: Historical event time, collector observation and capture time are separate. The hourly rows can be backfilled. This immutable capture may only inform later decisions.

source_definitions.oi: Binance USD-M BTCUSDT, hourly snapshots in BTC and USDT
source_definitions.cvd: Binance USD-M BTCUSDT hourly signed CVD increment = 2*taker_buy_base - total_base; the cumulative CVD resets after a missing hour
source_definitions.funding: Separate Binance BTCUSDT and OKX BTC-USDT-SWAP settled funding rates. Binance archive lags when its API rejects the runner.
source_definitions.liquidation: Deribit BTC-PERPETUAL trades bearing liquidation flags; fixed 00:00 and 12:00 UTC one-hour samples, not full-market liquidations
source_definitions.premium: Matched UTC hourly Coinbase BTC/USD close vs Binance spot BTC/USDT (includes USD/USDT basis) and vs Bitstamp BTC/USD
